questions.question: What is the capital of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.funFact: Lucknow is famous for its polite manners and its delicious kebabs and biryani.

questions.question: The 'Pink City', capital of Rajasthan, is which city?
questions.funFact: Jaipur is called the Pink City because many of its old buildings are painted a pink colour.

questions.question: Chandigarh is the capital of Punjab and which other state?
questions.funFact: Chandigarh is a rare city that serves as the capital of two states at the same time.

questions.question: Shimla is the capital of Himachal Pradesh.
questions.funFact: Shimla sits high in the hills and was once the summer capital of British India.

questions.question: The capital of Uttarakhand is ___.
questions.funFact: Dehradun lies in a valley between the Himalayas and is known for its schools and litchi fruit.

questions.question: Match each North Indian state to its capital.
questions.funFact: Rajasthan is the largest state in India, so its capital Jaipur is an important travel hub.

questions.question: Which city is the capital of India?
questions.funFact: New Delhi became the capital of India in 1911, taking over from Kolkata.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a North Indian state?
questions.funFact: Kerala is far away in the south of India, along the Arabian Sea coast.

questions.question: What is the summer capital of Jammu & Kashmir?
questions.funFact: Srinagar is famous for its Dal Lake, where people live on houseboats and paddle small boats called shikaras.

questions.question: The capital of Punjab is Amritsar.
questions.funFact: The capital of Punjab is Chandigarh; Amritsar is famous for the Golden Temple.

questions.question: The Golden Temple is located in which North Indian city?
questions.funFact: The Golden Temple in Amritsar is the holiest place of the Sikh religion and runs one of the world's largest free kitchens.

questions.question: Rajasthan is the largest state of India by area.
questions.funFact: Rajasthan is so big it covers about a tenth of India's total area, and much of it is the Thar Desert.
